items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: when I met Lips in New York, when I got on the same bandstand with him

ctx.x: So one afternoon, I was out to Barry's Park, where -- I forget who, or -- and Lips Page was playing at that time.

I think it was Benny Morton. And the young lady called me to the door and said, "Little boy, would you give this note to Lips Page?" I say, "Yes'm." And I walked up to the bandstand. I said, "Lady there at the door sent this letter to Mr. Warm Jaws." (laughs)

Everybody in the band fell out in hysterics. Lips got mad. Now, to take you -- when I met Lips in New York, when I got on the same bandstand with him, I said, "What note was that, Mr. Warm Jaws?" And he jumped up and said, "I'll knock you down." He said, "I've only been called that once in my life." I say, "That was me." Small's Hotel
